title: Rehydrate the same pending guidance after a process restart
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `c1`, store `shared`). A suspended generator run must survive executor or MCP process restart and present the identical pending question. Uses the CheckpointStore / run-store seam from durable resume (`fangore_insp_durable_resume`, `fangore_transactional_durable_resume`) rather than a second recovery protocol. Tracks R-IOC-RESUME. He walks product steps (start, rebuild, inspect) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-05]
implementation: `GeneratorRunStore` (in-memory shared instance or checkpoint-backed) rehydrates `GeneratorRunRecord.pending_request` for a new `DurableGraphGenerator` instance.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
